messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, my mobile data isn’t working properly—it’s either extremely slow or just stops working altogether. I need this fixed, and I absolutely need to get excellent internet speed on my phone. I don’t have access to WiFi, so I need my mobile data to work perfectly. Can you help?
I can help you with your mobile data issue. To get started, I’ll need to verify your account. Could you please provide either your phone number, customer ID, or your full name and date of birth?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any other information to help fix my data issue.

Thank you for providing your information. I see your account is active and you have multiple lines. Could you please confirm which phone number (or line) is experiencing the mobile data issue? This will help me check the correct line and resolve your problem as quickly as possible.
The issue is with my line—555-123-2002. That’s the one where mobile data keeps stopping or is way too slow.

{"plan_id": "P1002", "name": "Premium Plan", "data_limit_gb": 15.0, "price_per_month": 65.0, "data_refueling_price_per_gb": 2.0}

Thank you for confirming the line. Your line (555-123-2002) is active, on the Premium Plan with a 15GB monthly data limit, and you’ve used about 8.7GB so far. Roaming is enabled, and your plan is current.

To diagnose the slow or interrupted mobile data, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- What network signal strength you see (bars or icons)?
- If you see any icons like “4G”, “5G”, “LTE”, or “E”?
- If there are any unusual icons, such as airplane mode or data saver?

This will help me pinpoint the issue and guide you through the next steps.
(guides the customer through a device action)
Status Bar: ✈️ Airplane Mode | 🔋 80%

My phone’s status bar is currently showing the airplane mode icon, and the battery is at 80%. I don’t see any signal bars or network type icons like “4G”, “5G”, or “LTE” right now. What should I do next?

It looks like Airplane Mode is enabled on your phone, which disables all wireless connections—including mobile data and cellular service. To restore your mobile data, please turn off Airplane Mode. 

Once you’ve done that, check if your signal bars and network type icons (like “4G” or “5G”) reappear. Let me know what you see after turning off Airplane Mode, and if your mobile data starts working again.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📵 Data Disabled | 🔋 80%

I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. Now, my status bar shows excellent signal strength, “5G” for network type, but there’s also an icon indicating data is disabled. The battery is still at 80%. What should I do next? My mobile data still isn’t working.

Since your phone is showing “data is disabled,” you’ll need to turn on mobile data to restore your internet connection. 

Please enable mobile data in your phone’s settings or quick settings menu. Once you’ve done that, check if your internet starts working and if the data icon appears in your status bar. Let me know if this resolves the issue or if you still experience problems.
(guides the customer through a device action)

Mobile Data is now ON.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I’ve turned on mobile data. Now my status bar shows excellent signal strength, “5G,” and data is enabled. What should I do next to check if my internet speed is excellent?

Great! Now that mobile data is enabled and you have a strong 5G signal, please run a speed test on your phone. This will help us determine if your internet speed is excellent or if there are still issues.

Let me know the results of the speed test, especially the download speed and any quality indicators it provides. If you need instructions on how to run a speed test, just let me know!
(guides the customer through a device action)
Speed Test Result: 275.00 Mbps (Excellent). Connection is very fast.
I ran a speed test, and the result shows a download speed of 275 Mbps with the connection quality listed as “Excellent.” It looks like my internet speed is finally excellent now!

That’s great to hear! Your download speed of 275 Mbps and the “Excellent” connection quality indicate that your mobile data is now working perfectly.

If you have any other questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask. Otherwise, you’re all set to enjoy fast mobile internet on your phone!

Thanks for your help! Everything is working perfectly now. I appreciate your assistance. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
Post-call QA note: issue confirmed resolved during the call; environment checks passed.
